module_summary: N-to-1 UDP frame multiplexer: on frame start it latches the select input and selected header into registers, then routes the chosen payload AXI stream through a skid buffer until tlast.

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: Two-state frame-in-progress flag; set at header accept, cleared on tlast, gates payload transfer

anchors.name: select_reg
anchors.why: Latched port select steering payload data, valid, ready and last muxes

anchors.name: select
anchors.why: Input select choosing which source port's header and frame to forward

anchors.name: enable
anchors.why: Enables starting a new frame transfer from the selected input

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Per-port UDP header valid; selected bit starts a frame

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_ready
anchors.why: One-hot header ready pulse to the selected input port

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Concatenated input payload data of all ports, muxed by select_reg

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Per-port input payload valid, muxed to current valid

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Per-port payload ready asserted only on the selected port during a frame

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Output header valid set when a frame header is latched

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream header accept clearing header valid

anchors.name: m_ip_source_ip_reg
anchors.why: Representative latched header field register driving output header ports

anchors.name: current_s_tdata
anchors.why: Payload data mux output selected by select_reg

anchors.name: current_s_tvalid
anchors.why: Selected port valid used for end-of-frame detection and output valid

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output payload data from skid buffer output register

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from skid buffer

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream payload ready controlling skid buffer and input backpressure

anchors.name: temp_m_udp_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp register holding payload while output stalls

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tready_int_early
anchors.why: Early ready from skid buffer gating selected input ready

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Skid buffer enable loading muxed payload into output register

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Skid buffer enable storing payload into temp register on stall

groups.name: frame_control
groups.description: Frame-start detection, select latching and per-port ready generation

groups.name: header_registers
groups.description: Header fields of selected port latched at frame start

groups.name: payload_mux
groups.description: Indexed mux selecting the active input payload stream

groups.name: output_skid_buffer
groups.description: Two-register skid buffer driving output payload AXI stream
